import os,glob,re

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

    return 0

}

            vals = [row[c] for c in reg_cols]

                # Success: use this value

                # Mark this region as tried for this position
                tried_for_j0_to_3[j].add(candidate_region)
                break
